title: Tukar live demo
note: The live demo on its own, cut from the same captures and the same narration clips as the full video. Scene ids match cuts/full.json, so no re-capture and no re-recording is needed: switch with node cut.mjs livedemo and render.

scenes.vo: This is Tukar, a private remittance corridor on Stellar. Everything here runs on public testnet, and every receipt is one you can check yourself.
captions: This is Tukar, a private remittance corridor on Stellar.
Everything here runs on public testnet,
and every receipt is one you can check yourself.

scenes.vo: A sender connects a testnet key in one tap. Two hundred dollars to Mexico, with the corridor's cap read from an on-chain policy registry.
captions: A sender connects a testnet key in one tap.
Two hundred dollars to Mexico,
with the corridor's cap read from an on-chain policy registry.

scenes.vo: The compliance proof is built on the phone: allow-listed, not sanctioned, bound to this key. It really takes about thirty seconds, so the clip runs fast and says so.
captions: The compliance proof is built on the phone: allow-listed, not sanctioned, bound to this key.
It really takes about thirty seconds, so the clip runs fast and says so.

scenes.vo: Real testnet USDC enters the shielded pool and the note joins the Merkle tree. The ledger carries a commitment, not an amount or a recipient.
captions: Real testnet USDC enters the shielded pool and the note joins the Merkle tree.
The ledger carries a commitment, not an amount or a recipient.

scenes.vo: The receiver claims with a bearer note. No seed phrase, and no account with us.
captions: The receiver claims with a bearer note.
No seed phrase, and no account with us.

scenes.vo: The payout rate is read on-chain from Reflector, and the withdraw fails closed when the live quote sits under the contract's floor.
captions: The payout rate is read on-chain from Reflector,
and the withdraw fails closed when the live quote sits under the contract's floor.

scenes.vo: The withdraw settles on-chain, and only at that edge does an amount become public. That edge is what a compliance officer works with.
captions: The withdraw settles on-chain, and only at that edge does an amount become public.
That edge is what a compliance officer works with.

scenes.vo: The holder discloses one fact on the device: an exact amount, a threshold, a range, or an aggregate. Not a key, and not their history.
captions: The holder discloses one fact on the device:
an exact amount, a threshold, a range, or an aggregate.
Not a key, and not their history.

scenes.vo: A regulator pastes the receipt. It is checked twice, in the browser and by the same verifier contract the pool calls.
captions: A regulator pastes the receipt.
It is checked twice, in the browser and by the same verifier contract the pool calls.

scenes.vo: Change one character and it is rejected. A proof that verifies but is not bound to on-chain state is rejected too, and named as that.
captions: Change one character and it is rejected.
A proof that verifies but is not bound to on-chain state is rejected too, and named as that.

scenes.vo: That was one real payment, end to end on testnet: shielded in the middle, proved at the edge, and checkable by anyone. No users yet, and we say so.
captions: That was one real payment, end to end on testnet:
shielded in the middle, proved at the edge, and checkable by anyone.
No users yet, and we say so.
